chapter.heading: Psalm 43
Send Out Your Light and Your Truth
chapter.v:
Vindicate me,
O God,,
and defend my cause against an ungodly people, from the deceitful and unjust man deliver me!

For you
are the,
God in whom I take refuge; why have you rejected me? Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Send out
your light,
and your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling!

Then I
will go,
to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy, and I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.

Why are
you cast,
down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my salvation and my God. (ESV)
